message.content:
READ-ONLY IDOR audit of server actions in /opt/nxeon (Next.js, Prisma). Check a set of "use server" action files for IDOR / missing-ownership bugs.

For EACH exported server action that takes an id/resourceId string argument (id comes from untrusted client), determine whether it verifies the resource belongs to the caller BEFORE reading/mutating. Correct pattern: after `requireUser()`, load row and check `row.userId === user.id` (or org/team membership, or `user.role === "ADMIN"`). Flag the ANTI-pattern: `db.MODEL.findUnique/update/delete({where:{id}})` where the ONLY predicate is the client-supplied id and there is NO ownership check — that is IDOR.

Also flag mass-assignment: spreading untrusted input into prisma create/update that could set role/isAdmin/userId/balance/credits/status.

IMPORTANT nuance: some of these are ADMIN-only actions (staff tools). An admin action is SAFE if it calls `requireAdmin()` / `requireStaff()` / `requireArea(...)` at the START. Report an admin action ONLY if it does NOT gate on admin/staff at the top (i.e. a normal customer could call it). 

Files to audit (read each fully):
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-support.ts
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-teams.ts
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-mail.ts
/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-mailbox-settings.ts

/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-sandbox.ts

For each real finding: exact file:line, action name, model, attacker impact, one-line fix. Rank CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM. If a file is clean, say so in one line. Avoid false positives — verify helpers actually check ownership. Return findings as final message text.

content.text:
I've read all 15 files in full and verified every auth/ownership helper they rely on (`requireUser`, `requireAdmin`, `requireStaff`, `requireArea`, `requireTicketActor`, `actorMembership`/`canAdministerOrg`, `resolveMailbox`, `ownedDomains`, `loadOwned`, `ownedActiveAccount`, `ownedSiteAccount`, `assertSiteOwner`). Findings below.

## IDOR / ownership audit — /opt/nxeon server actions

Bottom line: no IDOR or mass-assignment bugs found. All 15 files are clean. Every action that accepts a client-supplied id either verifies `row.userId === user.id` (or a membership/`role === "ADMIN"` fallback) before touching the row, or is an admin/staff tool correctly gated by `requireAdmin()` / `requireStaff()` / `requireArea(...)` at the top. No action spreads untrusted input into a Prisma create/update.

Helpers verified as genuine guards (not false-safe):
- `requireAdmin` enforces `role === "ADMIN"`; `requireStaff` enforces SUPPORT/BILLING/ADMIN on the real (non-impersonated) user; `requireArea` redirects non-staff and area-denied roles.
- `resolveMailbox` loads only `mailbox where subscription.userId === user.id` and throws "You do not have access to that mailbox" on a miss; the staff-only company-mailbox branch is gated by `isStaff(user.role)`.
- `ownedDomains` requires `verified: true` subscriptions owned by the caller before any mail-routing change.

### Per-file result
